name: Iskole
overview: To escape a forced marriage to a wealthy businessman, a dedicated teacher leaves her city life behind for a transfer to a remote rural village. There, she discovers a gifted young dancer and vows to nurture her talent. When a corrupt politician threatens to close down the underfunded village school, she joins forces with passionate fellow teachers and a kind-hearted local entrepreneur. Together, they rally the community to save the school, while she fights to protect mistreated village children and resist her family's relentless pressure to return home.
